root_cause: Unparenthesized .eqv. inside an .and. chain allowed Fortran logical precedence to break the intended field-by-field exact-key conjunction when extension flags were false.
finding: Fingerprint collisions no longer weaken exact hydraulic-key authority. Distinct exact keys sharing a fingerprint remain separate registry entries.
nonclaims: The repair does not change the fingerprint algorithm.
No hydraulic representation or performance claim follows from this correctness repair.
